headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of July 28, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 13.47%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 9.33%. This results in an average alpha of 4.13%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 46.21%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 6.48%, which is still above the benchmark but indicates less strength relative to the top performer. This outperformance during the year-to-date period highlights the portfolio's resilience amidst potential market uncertainties. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
